messages:
lucas: Quick sync: we need a compact, stable set of client-facing error categories for the console + SDKs. Right now the UI shows internal routing codes and PMs are confused.
emily: Agreed. Can we define a tiny API contract (enum + two small hints) that SDKs and console can rely on? Keep it stable for telemetry.
sienna: Proposal: 4 enums only: TRANSIENT, QUOTA, DEGRADED, PERMANENT. Map each to a short display string in the localization layer.
dmitri: Naming nit: PERMANENT vs TERMINAL. PERMANENT feels slightly softer for customers; both are fine if enum is stable.
lucas: API fields I want in the contract: error_category (enum), short_text (displayable), retry_hint (retryable/no-retry), fallback_source (optional), quota_reset_seconds (optional). Tiny.
emily: Example SDK payload (RFC example): {"error_category":"QUOTA","short_text":"Quota — limit exceeded","retry_hint":"no-retry","quota_reset_seconds":"1800"} — include as literal in RFC.
sienna: Routing policy notes: TRANSIENT -> eligible for automatic retry/fanout; DEGRADED -> best-effort responses with reduced features; QUOTA -> do NOT auto-fallback (respect tenant budget); PERMANENT -> surface actionable message.
dmitri: Observability: emit both old_internal_code and new_error_category for 30 days during rollout. Also add headers for callers to inspect: X-Routing-Reason and X-Fallback-Source.
lucas: Console UX: show icon + short_text; tooltip shows retry_hint + brief explainer. Tooltip copy example: "Transient: temporary issue, we will retry automatically." Keep <80 chars.
emily: Colors: TRANSIENT=amber, DEGRADED=orange, QUOTA=blue (non-alarm), PERMANENT=red. Icon idea for QUOTA: stacked coins / shield.
sienna: Rollout plan: feature-flag the enum (client_error_enum_v2). Start emitting new metrics and header in canary, emit both metric tags for 30d, flip console when stable.
dmitri: Migration mapping quick draft: ROUTE_FAIL -> TRANSIENT; DEGRADED -> DEGRADED; OVER_LIMIT -> QUOTA; INTERNAL -> PERMANENT. We'll formalize table in RFC.
lucas: SDK behavior: if retry_hint=="retryable" SDKs should retry with exponential backoff; if "no-retry" surface a short CTA to upgrade/support. Also include a small SDK test asserting headers are present on fallback.
emily: Canary schedule: deploy-bot: feature flag rollout (canary) planned for 2024-12-10T03:00Z. Please add to runbook. :calendar:
deploy-bot: notice: feature-flag client_error_enum_v2 enabled in canary on 2024-12-10T03:00Z.
sienna: I'll open the RFC PR with sample payloads, the metric migration table, the console copy, and the rollout checklist. Any objections to the 4-bucket model?
dmitri: No objections from infra. Add a test harness to translate legacy metrics to enums for dashboards.
emily: SGTM. If folks want different short_texts for i18n we can iterate but do not change enum names.
lucas: Great. I'll create the RFC and tag relevant owners. Thanks everyone.
